purpose: Materialize final Hero job display stats after Stage 4 base stats by applying explicit Hero Fetter percentage effects, SP second-stage Hero-stat percentage effects where released, and HeartFetter level-10 percentage/flat effects. Stage 6 consumes this artifact without semantic recomputation.

semanticRules.normalBondSource: Stage 5-1 gotSkillId -> ConfigDataSkillInfo.ID -> PassiveBuffs_ID -> ConfigDataBuffInfo.ID -> explicit Property1..4_ID/Value
semanticRules.heartFetterLv10Flat: HeroHeartFetterSkills[9] -> SkillInfo.ID; parse only the already-validated Hero HP/DEF/MDEF flat description shape
semanticRules.heartFetterLv10Percent: UnlockSkills_ID entry with HeartFetterLevel=10 -> SkillInfo.ID; require the already-validated Hero all-stat +5% description
semanticRules.spJobRelation: Stage 5-4 sp.job.jobConnectionId -> ConfigDataJobConnectionInfo.ID -> JobLevels_ID -> ConfigDataJobLevelInfo.ID; choose the final level by JobLevelUpHeroLevel then ID
semanticRules.globalMasteryFlat: Reuse the Stage 4 materialized finalDisplayStats.components.*.masteryFlat; do not rederive mastery ownership
semanticRules.centralPercentFormula: round(starAdjustedRaw * 0.05) separately per stat, then add to the pre-central value
semanticRules.centralFlatOrder: Add explicit HeartFetter level-10 HP/DEF/MDEF flat values after percentage terms

boundaries.sourcePackAccess: maintenance-only through scripts/lib/configdata-direct.cjs and the pinned ConfigData source-pack contract

completionCriteria: SP release parity is exactly 25 released Heroes
all normal and SP values are non-negative integers
Leon SP Job 377 equals hp=4929, at=623, magic=233, df=300, magicDf=280, dex=130 with zero tolerance
Leon normal Hero bond rate resolves to 25% for all six Hero stats
Leon SP second-stage bonus resolves to HP +5% and DEF +5%
no Stage 4 semantic mutation, name JOIN, ID arithmetic, or runtime raw ConfigData dependency is introduced
promotionRule: Promote from CANDIDATE only after the owning validator passes on repository-generated output. Stage 6 and frontend wiring remain non-scope until promotion.
